race.comment: MR CICCONI (2) is an entire by Nicconi on debut for the Tom Dabernig yard who looks a good chance first time out. He's been jumping out well and looked sharp winning his latest. Drawn low and should take catching with Bates booked. PASTORAL KING (3) is an entire by Hanseatic out of a good mare on debut for the Mitchell Freedman yard. His latest jumpout at Donald was good and he should be ready to run well. IRON STUPA (1) ran well fresh at Tatura to grab second, beaten half a length. Tough draw but should take holding out. RAKIYNN (5) has been okay his past two after striking a heavy track on debut. He should be running on. COOL AZA BREEZE (7) has been going well and is in the minor mix again.
